shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f | head -50

sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ------; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ------; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | xargs ls -la

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && sed -n 1,80p build/docs/INDEX.md; ls build/docs/blocks build/docs/guides; grep -n -i -A25 "required setup\|## Usage\|Quick start" README.md | head -90

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks && sed -n 1,80p Header.md; echo =====; sed -n 1,70p Banner.md; echo =====; sed -n 1,60p PromoFeaturesBlock.md; echo ====; sed -n 1,50p ExtendedFeatures.md

sed -n 50,90p ExtendedFeatures.md; grep -n -i "dynamic-import\|sass" ../../../README.md | head; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; ls node_modules | grep -i "^sass\|dynamic-import"; npm view vite-plugin-dynamic-import version peerDependencies 2>&1|head
sed -n 505,560p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md; npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | grep -v "^npm warn" | tail -5

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='vite.config.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("export default defineConfig({\n","export default defineConfig({\n  resolve: {\n    // page-constructor CSS uses webpack-style `~pkg` imports\n    alias: [{ find: /^~/, replacement: '' }],\n  },\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|@import\|sass-lang\|^\s*[│╷╵]\|^$\|root stylesheet\|@use\|More info" | tail -20
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v -i "deprecat\|@import\|sass-lang\|^\s*[│╷╵]\|^$\|root stylesheet\|@use\|More info\|node_modules/@gravity" | tail -20
